The '''Probe Droid DX''' was a model of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] at the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial forces]] uploaded [[Computer virus/Legends|computer viruses]] to a number of probe droids outside of the factory.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Probe Droid DX's appear as enemies in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found in the Okara Droid Factory on the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
